title: Elon Musk says ousting Jensen Huang is like ‘kicking Michael Jordan off your team’
lede: At the DealBook Summit, Elon Musk called Nvidia's removal of Jensen Huang a mistake, likening it to cutting Michael Jordan during a winning streak, and rejected the idea that Huang was disloyal to the US.

points: Nvidia's board removed Huang after reports of extramarital affairs, including one with a woman US officials suspect of spying for Beijing.
Musk signed a petition with over 200,000 others to reinstate Huang and said on X he would hire him; the board says Huang is not coming back.
He argued Huang's decades of relationships and staff loyalty cannot be replaced, citing employees who turned down better offers to stay.
Anduril CEO Palmer Luckey also backed Huang, saying China wants him gone.
Satya Nadella and Sam Altman expressed confidence in Nvidia under interim CEO Colette Kress.
